method: Static analysis only - javap -c -p on the named 1.21.11 jars (client-named.jar for client classes, server-game-named.jar for server classes) for every vanilla method in scope, Rust source reads, data checks against Mojang's datagen report (no horizon-prepare output exists for 1.21.11), a diff of every in-scope oracle source between the 1.21.10 and 1.21.11 trees, and a full javac fixpoint measurement of all 391 oracle files on three classpaths (both 127/391 pass, client 127/391, server 102/391). No drivers were run and no oracle repairs were done (checks + triage only).
name: Items
out_of_scope_failures: Hoglin in the shared allowed_in_peaceful denylist (mobs/spawn_rules.rs:134-175, 38 entries = vanilla 1.21.11's 37 notInPeaceful types + Hoglin; vanilla has no hoglin) - Batch 3's scope (B3-G04, including the spawn-egg facet; the 1.21.11 Batch 3 report has not landed). Enderman teleport on the absent #entities_can_teleport_to (mobs/enderman.rs:117) and pet teleport (mobs/tame.rs:1341) and mob-head visibility via the minecraft:mob_visibility component (mobs.rs:3173) - Batch 3. Composter dead (composter.rs:24-25 reads minecraft:compostable, which does not exist in 1.21.11; vanilla uses a hardcoded COMPOSTABLES map) - Batch 5 (B5-G22). #entities_can_teleport_to at game/commands/world_cmds.rs:2100-2105 - Batch 8. Suspected duplicates flagged for the coordinator to fold: B7-G10 ~ B1-G03 (splash water), B7-G11 ~ B5-G19 (mud tag), B7-G17 ~ B3-G39 (spawner entity_data). The ServerLevel-ctor group (85 oracle files) and the bindComponents group (25 oracle files) belong to Batch 0.
source: docs/PARITY-SWEEP.md section 4 Batch 7 - checks + triage only, no fixes. Scope: item use, food, tools, armour, buckets, spawn eggs, components - 1,505 items. The item->Java-class map was extracted fresh from the named 1.21.11 jar: all 1,505 items mapped to 70 classes, 0 unmapped, 0 multi-class segments. Checks: 45 total (45 behaviour + 0 non-behaviour), 31 pass, 14 gap.
systemic_note: The 1.21.11 template fixed one oracle the 1.21.10 run never had passing (B7-O09 VanillaItemModelOracle, substantively adapted to 1.21.11's model API) and matches vanilla 1.21.11 where vanilla changed since 1.21.7 (bucket sneak, peaceful gate, ENTITY_PLACE position) - but every behaviour defect from 1.21.10 reproduces verbatim, including the four re-check-first regressions (G07 tool transforms, G08 campfire douse, G09 chorus fruit, G10 splash water). No new behaviour defect was found in scope. Ten oracle defects (O31-O40) are NEW to this run's ledger: they failed in the 1.21.10 measured table too but no 1.21.10 batch recorded them (provisional triage from the 26.1.2 table, where they passed). The 1.21.10 run's B7-O11 FIXED verdict for KnockbackClient was a provisional-triage error - the measured 1.21.10 table already shows it failing, and it fails in 1.21.11 with 7 errors (punch cause gone, new causes replace it). Vanilla changed between 1.21.10 and 1.21.11 in item scope: mob buckets gained food components, parched joined the peaceful denylist (37 types), spears/nautilus content arrived (B37 PASS).
